proposition_text: A person must not spread organic manure within 10 metres of surface water, except where permitted by specific exemptions for livestock manure or precision spreading equipment.
label: Prohibition on spreading organic manure within 10 metres of surface water
conditions: exception: permitted by paragraph (2) for livestock manure on specified land
exception: permitted by paragraph (4) for slurry, sewage sludge or anaerobic digestate using precision equipment
affected_subjects: organic manure within 10 metres of surface water
notes: Core prohibition with clear exceptions cross-referenced to subsequent paragraphs.
review_notes: Core prohibition with clear exceptions cross-referenced to subsequent paragraphs.

extraction_debug_meta.evidence_quote: A person must not spread organic manure within 10 metres of surface water, except in so far as doing so is permitted by paragraph (2) or (4).

proposition_text: Livestock manure (other than slurry or poultry manure) may be spread within 10 metres of surface water on land managed for breeding wader birds or species-rich semi-natural grassland that is notified as SSSI or subject to agri-environmental commitment, during 1st June to 31st October, provided it is not spread directly on surface water and does not exceed 12.5 tonnes per hectare annually.
label: Exception for livestock manure on designated conservation land
short_name: Livestock manure (other than slurry or poultry manure) may be spread
legal_subject: Livestock manure (other than slurry or poultry manure)
conditions: spread on land managed for breeding wader birds or as a species-rich semi-natural grassland
land is notified as SSSI under Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981 or subject to agri-environmental commitment under Council Regulation (EC) 1698/2005 or Regulation (EU) 1305/2013
spread in the period that begins with 1st June and ends with the following 31st October
not spread directly on to surface water
total annual amount does not exceed 12.5 tonnes per hectare
notes: Exception with multiple cumulative conditions clearly specified across paragraphs (2) and (3).
review_notes: Exception with multiple cumulative conditions clearly specified across paragraphs (2) and (3).

extraction_debug_meta.evidence_quote: Livestock manure (other than slurry or poultry manure) may be spread if— a it is spread on land managed for breeding wader birds or as a species-rich semi-natural grassland and the land comes within paragraph (3), b it is spread in the period that begins with 1st June and ends with the following 31st October, c it is not spread directly on to surface water, and d the total annual amount does not exceed 12.5 tonnes per hectare. 3 Land comes within this paragraph if it is— a notified as a site of special scientific interest under the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981, or b subject to an agri-environmental commitment entered into under Council Regulation (EC) 1698/2005 or Regulation (EU) 1305/2013.

proposition_text: Organic manure in the form of slurry, sewage sludge or anaerobic digestate may be spread within 10 metres but not within 6 metres of surface water if the spreading equipment is a trailing hose band spreader, trailing shoe band spreader, injector (no deeper than 10cm), or dribble bar applicator.
label: Exception for slurry, sewage sludge and anaerobic digestate using precision equipment
short_name: Organic manure in the form of slurry, sewage sludge or anaerobic digestate may be spread
legal_subject: Organic manure in the form of slurry, sewage sludge or anaerobic digestate
conditions: spreading equipment is a trailing hose band spreader or a trailing shoe band spreader
spreading equipment is an injector which injects the organic manure no deeper than 10cm below the surface of the soil
spreading equipment is a dribble bar applicator
affected_subjects: within 10 metres but not within 6 metres of surface water
notes: Exception with alternative equipment conditions (disjunctive list) and clear spatial limit.
review_notes: Exception with alternative equipment conditions (disjunctive list) and clear spatial limit.

extraction_debug_meta.evidence_quote: Organic manure in the form of slurry, sewage sludge or anaerobic digestate (or any combination of those) may be spread, except within 6 metres of surface water, if the spreading equipment used is— a a trailing hose band spreader or a trailing shoe band spreader, b an injector which injects the organic manure no deeper than 10cm below the surface of the soil, or c a dribble bar applicator.

proposition_text: A person must not spread organic manure within 50 metres of a borehole, spring or well.
label: Prohibition on spreading organic manure within 50 metres of water sources
affected_subjects: organic manure within 50 metres of a borehole, spring or well

proposition_text: The restrictions on spreading organic manure near surface water and water sources do not apply to land which is covered by a greenhouse.
